scripts.test: npm run allure:carry-history && node scripts/run-with-allure.js allure-results allure-report -- npx playwright test
scripts.test:headed: npm run allure:carry-history && cross-env HEADLESS=false node scripts/run-with-allure.js allure-results allure-report -- npx playwright test
scripts.test:chrome: npm run allure:carry-history && node scripts/run-with-allure.js allure-results allure-report -- npx playwright test --project=Chrome

scripts.test:smoke:chrome: node scripts/allure-carry-history.js allure-results/smoke allure-report/smoke && node scripts/run-with-allure.js allure-results/smoke allure-report/smoke -- npx playwright test --grep @smoke --project=Chrome
scripts.test:regression: node scripts/allure-carry-history.js allure-results/regression allure-report/regression && node scripts/run-with-allure.js allure-results/regression allure-report/regression -- npx playwright test --grep @regression
